scope: Only actual Cocos RigidBody, Collider, BoxCollider and SphereCollider used by Box3D. No constraints, other shapes, SDK/native work or external operations. No src edits.

recommendedStages.A: 37 first-statement assertions plus 3 imports across the four files. No backend branches, normalization or cache/delegate order changes.
recommendedStages.B: 4 first-statement Collider listener assertions are required, but native event dispatch must separately handle legitimate internal once/invalid-target removal while user configuration remains denied. No event support claim from these four guards.
recommendedStages.C: Owner/queue integration for the nine allowed force/impulse/torque/clear commands, not blanket component guards. Coordinate with the active src/air worker; do not edit those files in this task.

stagedCommandExceptions.decision: Do not add blanket assertMutationAllowed(this) here. These nine entries are allowed staged commands under a component lease during collection.
stagedCommandExceptions.oldBehavior: _isInitialized then adapter delegation, without local caller vector reads or cache mutation. Current adapter implementation is in active World-owner work; this audit does not modify or qualify it.
stagedCommandExceptions.requiredOwnerProof: Adapter must enter queue.withSubmissionAdmission before owner validation or argument reads, obtain/reuse leases inside its reader, hold them through full copy/enqueue, and poison candidate on caught nested rejected command. Never release a component lease to pass a command.

alreadyCorrect.reason: Existing Collider.material.set guard is the first statement, before adapter/listener/material-id reads.
Existing Collider.material.get guard precedes first clone/listener/cache effect, inside the private-field-only shared-material branch. Keep pure non-cloning reads available.
Inherited public lifecycle entries already guard component identity; do not duplicate protected lifecycle guards or expand into arbitrary direct/private calls.

Collider: material when no clone is needed
readsToKeepAvailable.note: Velocity output writes are caller-owned output mutation, not engine cache mutation. Output setters may execute caller code; nested engine writes remain fenced. Direct vector/object aliases, private method calls and overridden methods are not sandboxed.

inheritedEventAudit.finding: Forwards directly to this.removeAll without input access. A guarded Collider.removeAll covers it before listener side effects; no additional override needed.
Inherited public API reads/coerces key, sets list.isInvoking, removes once/invalid-target callbacks via this.off before callback, invokes user code and may purge lists. It is not read-only.
inheritedEventAudit.requiredFollowUp: Do not silently claim this entry protected by on/off guards. A Collider.emit wrapper can refuse external emit before superclass work, but also blocks legitimate dispatch under the same lease. Requires a private exact dispatch admission or prevalidated dispatch design, not a global bypass or releasing owner leases.

inheritedEventAudit.finding: CallbacksInvoker.clear is mixed into runtime prototypes but omitted from typed IEventified surface; it clears tables directly and bypasses Collider.removeAll.
inheritedEventAudit.requiredFollowUp: Report as runtime/internal escape boundary. Do not broaden shared Eventify or invent a clear algorithm in this four-class source-only patch; explicit engine-private hardening would need separate scoped design.

verificationPlan: Use actual imported engine classes, Eventify, pools, geometry, Vec3 and Component lifecycle. No copied setter bodies. Snapshot all tested source/config/fixture identities before each retained run.

Retain ORIGINAL RED before editing any of the four sources, then run the exact immutable fixture against patched GREEN. Preserve every failed harness/type/format attempt. No runtime/native/WASM build is necessary for this source control.

Each proposed entry: explicitly register guard on the component identity; assert exact operation and immutable snapshots of scalar/vector caches, geometry cache identities/values, listener tables/flags and zero adapter/native-mock counts. Register a second independent lease, release only first, prove continued refusal; release last and prove recovery. Unrelated identity remains usable.

Cover initialized Box3D branch, no adapter/uninitialized branch and a representative non-Box3D branch. Leased same-value setters must reject before equality, and missing-adapter branches before error logging. No-lease controls preserve all existing early returns, warnings/normalization and backend ordering.

Poison/caught nested accessors: group/mass/damping/radius Symbol.toPrimitive/valueOf; Box.size x/y/z reads even in strictEquals; center/factor Vec3 getters; material id access; listener key coercion. Observe zero accessor/clone/listener/adapter activity under lease, not just a thrown error.

Bounds: both null-cache and populated-cache getter cases. Refusal must not allocate/replace or refresh either cache. No-lease repeated calls preserve cached object identity and normal refreshed values.

Listener stage uses real callback tables: on/off/once/removeAll and inherited targetOff, registered callbacks, invalid target, cancellation while invoking, flags and shape.updateEventListener counts. Establish once dispatch compatibility before event integration; current T15 unsupported adapter does not establish event delivery.

Committed reads: body cached getters, getLinear/AngularVelocity(out), filter getters, material shared/pure getter, collider shape/vector identities. Verify reads remain accessible during lease and do not call mutating delegates.

Command exceptions: separate owner test with valid force/impulse/torque/clear submission while component leased must enqueue without native writes; caught nested command refusal poisons candidate. A pure lease fixture is not valid reason to demand those allowed commands reject at the wrapper.

Record full raw errors, exact check values, stdout/stderr, type and format exits. Header and assertion-only diff audit. Keep formal native/browser cells unqualified and leave upstream map/docs updates to lead.
unresolvedBoundaries: CallbacksInvoker/Collider inherited event dispatch mutates its own listener machinery. Four listener guards alone cannot close emit or safely authorize internal once removal.
No-lease Box3D on/once already changes listeners and flags before current unsupported event adapter rejects. This patch must not claim to repair that preexisting no-lease transaction behavior.

Force/impulse/torque/ordinary clear methods are queue admissions, not forbidden configuration. Uninitialized wrapper _isInitialized still logs and returns under existing behavior; owner-level invalid/stale submission contracts require their own tests, not a new generic mutation guard.

Inherited generic Component name/scheduler utilities and engine-private lifecycle accessors are outside physics-configuration patch scope; existing enabled/destroy fences and Node category guard remain prerequisites.
No guards can protect direct public Vec3, result, material or private-field aliases; owner raw snapshot verification remains necessary.
